texas.seoDescription: Texas shelf for AJ Ghost. The live Houston page embeds a free short story. HUNTED, the Ryan Kane prequel, is free on BookFunnel.
texas.intro: Texas readers get a shelf, not a claim that the books happen there. The Ryan Kane Series is not set in Texas. This directory lists only the city pages that are actually published. Right now that is Houston: a page for people who want something short and dark after a late shift, with a free story embedded and the longer prequel waiting afterward. The story keeps its own address under free reads, so the city page can speak to its readers without pretending the fiction was rewritten for one highway. HUNTED, the Book 1 prequel, is free on BookFunnel. Fractured Ground is on Kindle. Digital Ascent, book three, is an advance copy on BookSprout. Other Texas cities stay off this list until their pages are real. Start with Houston if that is the night you are in, or go to the free reads if you want the stories on their own.
